actions.action: Count hours of direct sun in the spot
Finger-check soil moisture 3 cm deep daily for a few days
Hand-pollinate flowers by shaking stems or brushing inside flowers each morning
Move plants to sunniest spot with 6+ hours direct sun
Water when top 2-3 cm of soil is dry until it drains
Switch to tomato fertilizer every 2 weeks

reason: The answer blames poor pollination and heat and prescribes treatments, but the plant was healthy and only needed time to mature. The advice would not have caused the fix, though the extra care steps are unlikely to hurt the plant.
